name: Cock Standards — Two Floors, and a Trend
tagline: v8 kept the eight inches and the six inches and killed the pairing rule, because a measurement was doing role-work.
body:
TWO RULES SURVIVE v8 AND THEY ARE BOTH FLOORS ON ONE WOMAN’S BODY.
CHAOS AGENT LENGTH FLOOR — Brat, Gremlin or Menace: EIGHT INCHES flaccid minimum. Margin name: BIGGER CHAOS STICK.
GOTHIC GIRTH FLOOR — Witch, Occult or Femme Fatale: SIX INCHES flaccid circumference minimum, FOR THE AMBIENCE. Margin name: THICKER FOR THE AMBIENCE.
Both codings: both floors. FLOORS, NOT TARGETS. A woman may exceed hers and most do.

THE 1.5-INCH CHAOS AGENT / ANCHOR PAIRING RULE IS RETIRED. v8 REMOVED IT. Viraena gave three reasons and the Archive is recording all three as given.
A · IT REQUIRED TWO WOMEN. Every other rule in Nereid governs one body and can be checked against one chart. This one could not be evaluated without going and finding somebody else, which makes it a rule about a RELATIONSHIP wearing an anatomy rule’s coat.
B · IT FORCED THE CHAOS AGENT TO BE THE BOTTOM EVEN IF SHE WANTED TO TOP. AND THIS IS THE ONE THAT MATTERS, because it is the entire spine of the document arriving to kill its own clause. Pillar Four closes with HER ANATOMY IS REAL; ITS USE REMAINS HERS, and says outright that a woman may possess an enormous cock and prefer bottoming, or choose a smaller legal package and top relentlessly. PILLAR ONE SAYS BUILD DETERMINES NO SEXUAL ROLE. The Consent Menu attests that NEREID ASSIGNS NO SEXUAL ROLE THROUGH ANATOMY. THE 1.5 RULE WAS THE LAST PLACE IN THE SYSTEM WHERE A MEASUREMENT WAS STILL DOING ROLE-WORK, and v8 found it and removed it.
C · GIGGITY. Recorded as given, and it is a joke, and the Archive is not pretending otherwise.

WHAT REPLACES IT: NOTHING. IT IS A TREND IN THE COMPOUND AND NOT A RULE. The gaps that were cited as exemplars are still real and are still what those women chose — they simply explain nothing and oblige nobody.
BRYN 11.5 TO TORIE 10.0 — 1.5. LUMINA 10.2 TO ABBI 8.5 — 1.7. RAE 8.45 UNDER LIVI 10.25 — 1.8. LUNA 10.6 TO ALICE 8.9 — 1.7. BRIAR 10.5 OVER QUINN 8.8 — 1.7, with the brat holding the larger side.
FIVE PAIRS, ALL BETWEEN 1.5 AND 1.8, AND NOT ONE OF THEM REQUIRED TO BE. THAT CLUSTER IS THE TREND. The retired rule did not create it; it NOTICED it and then started issuing orders.

THE CONTESTED FLOOR CLAUSE DIES WITH THE RULE. There is no longer a figure to contest, no conversion from exact gap to minimum, and no fight to win. A Chaos Agent who wants to be larger than her Anchor simply IS, and owes nobody an argument about it.

TORIE ERIKSSON IS THE WORKED EXAMPLE AND HER ACT READS BETTER UNDER THE REMOVAL THAN IT DID UNDER THE RULE. She went and found out how big Bryn was HARD, did the arithmetic, and made sure her own erect length still sat 1.5 under. UNDER THE OLD RULE THAT WAS COMPLIANCE. UNDER v8 IT IS A PREFERENCE SHE WENT AND ENFORCED ON HERSELF FOR NO REASON EXCEPT THAT SHE WANTED IT. Viraena, to her, on the deck: YOU WERE NEVER GONNA BE BIGGER THAN BRYN. SHE MAXED OUT THE HARDNESS, AND THE GIRTH. AND YOU LIKE MATCHING THE SCALE BUT BEING SHORTER IN LENGTH.
WHICH IS A STATEMENT OF TASTE, AND IT IS HERS, AND NO DOCUMENT ISSUED IT.

AND IT SETTLES BRYN’S ERECT GIRTH. SHE MAXED THE HARDNESS AND THE GIRTH: 11.5 — 12.1 is plus 0.6, the length ceiling, and 6.6 — 7.0 is plus 0.4, THE CIRCUMFERENCE CEILING. BOTH AT MAXIMUM.

PANTY CANON, UNCHANGED: TANGAS, CHEEKIES, BRAZILIAN CUT, THONGS, G-STRINGS ONLY. NO BOXERS, BRIEFS OR BOY-SHORTS. NO TUCKING. THE BULGE IS A DECLARATION.
